title: Does a snowball shooter like this look fun to play with friends?
author: PossibilityCivil9884
selftext:
hey everyone, wanted to share some gameplay from Snowbody’s Safe and get your thoughts

It’s an arena shooter where you’re a snowball with guns, rolling around, grappling and picking upgrades while racing through a weapon ladder  
The first player to reach the final weapon becomes a giant boss and everyone else teams up to take them down

I’ve been building it in Godot with a lot of help from Codex, and I’m trying to figure out whether the actual gameplay looks appealing to other people

Could you see yourself playing this with friends for a few matches, if not can you elaborate to why?  
  
What would make you want to try it, and what would put you off?

Especially curious about the movement, shooting, visual clarity and whether the boss idea looks fun

The current [demo ](https://gremlinforgestudio.itch.io/snowbodys-safe-closed-playtest)is against bots, friend matches are the goal for the full game

Be honest, what would you change first?

https://reddit.com/link/1wxcvd8/video/lvd0ry2flfth1/player

comments.author: PossibilityCivil9884
comments.body: I just dont know how to get feedback on this game, need help if possible
